title: Ladybug in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf tails -->
  <path d='M58 56 Q68 60 64 72 Q60 78 54 74 Q58 66 54 58 Z' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <path d='M56 56 Q62 64 58 72' stroke='#ff9ec0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- body (shell) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e8272b'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- wing line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='38' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#b81c20' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='4' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='4' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='14' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 42 55 38' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='42' y1='22' x2='36' y2='12' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='22' x2='64' y2='12' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a1a'/>
  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d='M32 50 Q50 58 68 50 L67 56 Q50 64 33 56 Z' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <path d='M35 53 Q50 60 65 53' stroke='#ff9ec0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='28' y1='58' x2='16' y2='52' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='66' x2='14' y2='66' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='74' x2='16' y2='80' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='58' x2='84' y2='52' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='66' x2='86' y2='66' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='74' x2='84' y2='80' stroke='#2a1a1a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
